_comment: GATE-TRUST-2540 (TR-04): the source inputs of the shipped UI build (npm run build:addon). scripts/build-stamp.mjs hashes the tracked and untracked (not ignored) files under these paths into smplwise_vms/www/build-stamp.json; scripts/release_check.py recomputes the hash on the checkout under test and fails a release whose shipped bundle was not built from these exact sources.
